newsitem.title: USA: U.S. regional airline group elects new officers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. regional airline group elects new officers.

text.p: Regional Airline Association directors have elected Geoffrey Crowley, president of Air Wisconsin Airlines Corp, as its new chairman, the association said on Thursday.
It said it also elected Bryan Bedford of Mesaba Aviaton as vice chairman, Tom Cooper of Gulfstream International Airlines as secretary and John Leonard of Piedmont Airlines as treasurer.
The association is a trade group representing regional airlines and providers of products and services that support the industry.
